Nina (PM): Heads-up: MediCareX requested a beta with dedicated capacity but want clear SLAs + committed feedback before we sign. Need a tight pilot proposal by Tuesday. Can we sketch terms here?
Sam (Sales): Their budget window is tight. Suggest 2 options: (A) subsidized pilot: 2 months, 60% credits up to $20k + $3k/mo min, or (B) paid pilot: $15k flat for 2 months with 4 weeks total onboarding. They want 6 product sessions and weekly notes.
Jules (Design): For feedback quality we should require: 4 structured sessions (60m), 2 exec reviews (30m), and a blind eval at the end with 3 prompt families. Also require them to tag 40 negative examples and 40 positive ones for regressions.
Omar (Eng): Dedicated allocation is possible but need expected concurrency and average token length. If they go >30 qps we'll need a higher commit. Also ask if they need KV caching enabled (adds infra complexity).
Sam (Sales): I'll ask for usage samples. Quick ask to the customer: can you run our simple harness with 128/512/1024 seq_len and send back p50/p95 latency for a 10qps baseline?
Nina (PM): Draft launch gates: 1) integration + E2E demo, 2) P50 < 400ms and P99 < 1.1s for agreed load, 3) pass blind eval (>=4/5), 4) delivery of labeled examples and session notes.
ops-bot: Reminder: create a runbook entry for pilot customers.
Omar (Eng): I'll own rollback to hosted endpoints and a short runbook for their SREs. Also recommend feature-flagging any experimental prompts.
legal-bot: FYI: I'll prep a slim NDA + data handling appendix. Add a clause restricting PHI export and requiring encryption at rest.
Sam (Sales): Another commercial note: if they convert to Dedicated within 45 days give 20% onboarding credit toward first invoice.
Jules (Design): I'll drop a 10-question feedback template in the shared drive and a quick rubric for the blind eval.
Nina (PM): Great. Action list: Sam to get perf samples and budget signal; Omar to draft runbook + rollback; Jules to produce feedback form; legal-bot to draft NDA appendix. I'll synthesize terms and send to MediCareX. Target send time: Tuesday 5pm PST.
Sam (Sales): One more negotiation flag: customer asked for a temporary exclusivity clause in their region. We'll need to price that; I flagged for later.
Nina (PM): Noted. Thanks everyone — ping me if you need help. :white_check_mark:
